lignes.zh: 他把手机放在裤兜里，出门跑步。
lignes.pinyin: tā bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài kù dōu lǐ chū mén pǎo bù
lignes.fr: Il glisse son téléphone dans la poche de son pantalon et sort courir.
lignes.en: He puts his phone in his trouser pocket and goes out for a run.

lignes.zh: 鞋带没绑好，他差点摔倒。
lignes.pinyin: xié dài méi bǎng hǎo tā chà diǎn shuāi dǎo
lignes.fr: Son lacet était mal noué, il a failli tomber.
lignes.en: His shoelace wasn't tied properly and he nearly fell.

lignes.zh: 他停下来，重新绑了一下。
lignes.pinyin: tā tíng xià lái chóng xīn bǎng le yī xià
lignes.en: He stops and ties it again.

glossaire.en: (marks the object of the verb); to hold
